attr.title: Gold Box Game Engine
attr.desc: Plays SSI's Gold Box AD&D role-playing games - Pool of Radiance, Curse of the Azure Bonds, Secret of the Silver Blades, Pools of Darkness, the Savage Frontier and Krynn games - from your own copies of the original DOS game files, with controls made for handheld buttons. An open-source engine written from scratch; it contains nothing from the games.
attr.inst: You need your own copy of each game (the GOG or Steam releases). Copy each game's whole install folder into ports/goldbox/games/ - for example ports/goldbox/games/Curse of the Azure Bonds/ - and start the port.
